viewGuide: Four views of one scan: the whole axial slice where the centred label is largest, a zoomed axial crop, and coronal and sagittal cuts through the same point. Kidney is outlined in green and the kidney lesion in orange; the release does not say whether a lesion is a tumour or a cyst. Window 50/500 HU; radiological orientation (patient left on viewer right).
alt: Four views of CT BDMAP_00000061: axial, zoomed axial, coronal and sagittal, with kidney and kidney lesion outlines.
attribution: Images and masks: AbdomenAtlas 3.0 (Bassi et al., ICCV 2025, doi:10.1109/ICCV51701.2025.02202), Hugging Face AbdomenAtlas/AbdomenAtlas3.0Mini, revision 122e04f. The release does not record which of its 17 source datasets this scan came from. Rendered by the Kidney-VLM project: reoriented for display, windowed, cropped and outlined.
reuseTerms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/), the licence on the dataset card. This preview is an adaptation and is shared under the same licence. The RadGPT repository's LICENSE states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, which does not allow adaptations; a curator has to settle which applies before approving this preview.
alignment: The release's own CT and mask files; in this case they share one voxel grid and header (checked). Nothing was re-registered.

viewGuide: Five axial slices spread across the kidneys, side by side, exactly as DeepTumorVQA releases the image for its questions; per the paper they use a window of -150 to 250 HU. No outline is drawn.
alt: Five axial CT slices of BDMAP_00000162 side by side, as released by DeepTumorVQA.
attribution: Image: DeepTumorVQA 2.0 (Chen et al. 2026, arXiv:2605.09679), Hugging Face tumor-vqa/DeepTumorVQA_2.0, revision a8b9db5, benchmark/images_2d/organ/BDMAP_00000162_kidney.png, rendered by DeepTumorVQA from the AbdomenAtlas 3.0 scan BDMAP_00000162, which DeepTumorVQA's ID mapping gives as KiTS21_img0205 (KiTS, Heller et al.). Compressed to WebP for the atlas; nothing else was changed.
reuseTerms: Governed by the source CT licence, according to the DeepTumorVQA card, which points to AbdomenAtlas3.0Mini. That dataset's card states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/) and its repository CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. By DeepTumorVQA's ID mapping the scan is a KiTS case, and KiTS23 is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. A curator has to settle which applies before approving this preview.
alignment: No mask is drawn; the image is shown as released.

providerText.value: Small kidney stone in the right kidney and a small cyst.

viewGuide: Four views of one scan: the whole axial slice where the right kidney is largest, a zoomed axial crop, and coronal and sagittal cuts through the centre of the right kidney. Both kidneys are outlined in green; there is no stone or cyst mask. Window 50/500 HU; radiological orientation (patient left on viewer right).
alt: Four views of CT amos_0088: axial, zoomed axial, coronal and sagittal, with kidney outlines.
attribution: CT: AMOS-MM (MICCAI 2024 AMOS-MM challenge; Ji, Ge, Li and Luo), imagesTr/amos_0088.nii.gz from the public Google Drive release, which matches amos_0088 of AMOS22 in size and CRC32 (Ji et al., NeurIPS 2022; doi:10.5281/zenodo.7262581). Kidney mask: AMOS22 labelsTr/amos_0088.nii.gz. Rendered by the Kidney-VLM project: reoriented for display, windowed, cropped and outlined.
reuseTerms: Unresolved. The CT matches an AMOS22 file in size and CRC32, and AMOS22's own statements differ: its Zenodo record says CC BY 4.0, its dataset.json "CC-BY-SA 4.0" and the AMOS paper CC BY-NC-SA. AMOS-MM's JSON files state CC BY-ND 4.0, which does not allow adaptations, and its design document CC BY-SA. A curator has to settle which applies before approving this preview.
alignment: The AMOS22 mask and the AMOS-MM CT share one voxel grid and affine (checked). Nothing was re-registered.
